price_source.method: OpenRouter free catalogue tool list-model-endpoints (no inference, no spend)
price_source.list_price: owner planning price = cheapest standard endpoint, matches owner-note-22112026 03_BUDGET_AND_AUTONOMY.md
price_source.worst_endpoint_price: maximum prompt and completion price over every endpoint OpenRouter listed for the model; the caller reserves at this price because A3r1 does not pin provider routing
price_source.typhoon: no verified price or quota: excluded from every USD sum below and refused by the ledger (price_unknown) until verified

assumptions.source: owner budget_plan.json planning_assumptions (planning scenario, not a measured distribution)
assumptions.stage_b_count_basis: 25,626 - 2,000 + 1,919 from the owner package; to be re-verified against actual manifests before dispatch
assumptions.retries: not included (every retry is one more attempted request and its own reservation)

measured_request_body_bytes_dev_val.source: ../_private_artifacts/g03-a3/inputs/queries-dev-val.jsonl built with the frozen prompt (query texts only, no labels)

historical_reconciled.what: A3r0 format smoke via MCP, imported into the ledger as one historical E1 entry

workbench_reconciled.basis: no Workbench store at %LOCALAPPDATA%/PatentToPilot/workbench on 22 Nov 2026 and HANDOFF records that the real OpenRouter Workbench check still waits for the key; import_workbench_usage() imports any later pre-ledger rows

fit_under_E1_alone.ceiling_basis: E1 stop-and-report threshold (hard USD 8.00 needs a recorded continue_past_stop approval)
fit_under_E1_alone.calibration_plus_pilot_fits: yes at list prices (USD 2.09 cumulative); at worst-endpoint prices USD 5.94, which leaves USD 0.06 and is too tight to call safe
fit_under_E1_alone.why_not: the cheapest Stage B alone (DeepSeek V4 Flash, USD 7.31 at list price) exceeds the USD 6.00 stop; even the USD 8.00 hard limit is below every cumulative total (USD 9.40-13.07 at list prices)
fit_under_E1_alone.requests_fit: 33,677 of 35,000 before retries: 1,323 attempts of retry headroom (about 3.9%)
fit_under_E1_alone.scope_note: A3r1 is not named in E1's recorded scope (A3 as frozen + Workbench checks); whether A3r1 calibration may run under E1 is an owner decision

fit_under_E1R_if_approved.full_plan_fits_at_worst_endpoint_prices: yes for every candidate (max USD 45.28 if Stage B is DeepSeek V4 Flash), but DeepSeek at worst-endpoint prices passes the USD 40 notify point and leaves little of the reserve for structural/Thai work
fit_under_E1R_if_approved.against_owner_allocations: pilot list USD 2.06 vs allocation 6; Stage B list USD 7.31-10.98 vs allocation 18 (worst-endpoint DeepSeek USD 39.34 would not fit the 18 allocation)

recommendation_before_freeze: declare OpenRouter provider.max_price (or a provider order) per model in the A3r1 config before calibration, so the ledger reservation and the realised cost are bounded by the price the protocol assumes; record it as part of the A3r1 contract, not as a later runtime tweak
limitations: Planning scenario prices and token counts, not observed costs.
Worst-endpoint prices change as OpenRouter adds providers; they were read once on 2026-11-22.
Typhoon is unpriced and excluded from USD sums.
Retries, Workbench checks after 22 Nov, and structural/Thai work are not in these totals.
